description: Weekly version bumps for every pin in this repo. Built-in managers cover Dockerfiles, compose files, devcontainer features, package.json, pyproject.toml and GitHub Actions; the regex managers below cover pins Renovate cannot find on its own.

devcontainer.description: Templates keep their .devcontainer/ below templates/*/scaffold/, not at the repo root

customManagers.description: Template pins annotated on the line above: '# renovate: datasource=<ds> depName=<name> [versioning=<v>] [extractVersion=<re>]' ('//' in JSON files). The version is the first number on the next line not glued to a letter, digit or dot ("3.14" in '"python3": "3.14"'; v1.2 is not read). A new template needs no change here.
pnpm version option of the node feature (the devcontainer manager already tracks Node itself)
Gradle version option of the java feature
npm global installs in Dockerfiles: @devcontainers/cli, pnpm
devcontainer-cli image tag follows the CLI version

packageRules.description: One PR per template: a template's pins (runtime, its images, tools) must stay in step, and CI tests the template as a whole. A new template gets its own group with no change here. Elsewhere, Renovate's default already puts every file pinning the same dependency in one PR.
